evals.name: safe-mysql-query
evals.prompt: Query an order record by ID and status in MySQL using database/sql with context timeout.
evals.expected_output: Parameterized query with '?' placeholders, context propagation, and error checking.
assertions: Uses '?' placeholders for parameterized query parameters.
Handles sql.ErrNoRows explicitly and maps to domain not found error.

evals.name: deadlock-retry-handling
evals.prompt: A high-concurrency MySQL transaction fails with Error 1213 (ER_LOCK_DEADLOCK). Implement retry logic.
evals.expected_output: Error inspection for MySQL error number 1213 and exponential backoff retry.
assertions: Retries transaction with bounded attempts and jittered backoff.
Rolls back failed transaction attempt before retrying.

evals.name: connection-pool-tuning
evals.prompt: Configure database/sql connection pool parameters for a MySQL production microservice.
evals.expected_output: Setting SetMaxOpenConns, SetMaxIdleConns, and SetConnMaxLifetime based on server capacity.
assertions: Configures SetMaxOpenConns to avoid exhausting MySQL max_connections.
Sets SetMaxIdleConns appropriately (typically equal to or slightly lower than MaxOpenConns).
Sets SetConnMaxLifetime to be shorter than MySQL wait_timeout to prevent dead connection reuse.
